weekPlan.aero: Setup only, no modeling yet. Create the GitHub account and a repo called aerospace-portfolio with a README. Install Fusion 360 with your .utexas.edu email (free education license). Order the ESP32 starter kit (~$35: board, breadboard, jumpers, LEDs, resistors, buttons, SG90 servo).
weekPlan.aeroDone: Repo exists and is public. Fusion opens. Kit ordered with a delivery date before October.
weekPlan.py: Git itself, not Python yet. Learn commit, branch, push, and how to write a README in Markdown.
weekPlan.pyDone: Three commits pushed to aerospace-portfolio from your own machine.
weekPlan.apps: Confirm export-control / US person eligibility — it determines half your target list. Create your NASA STEM Gateway profile. Rebuild the resume per the Resume_Plan tab.
weekPlan.debt: If you miss a day here, double up Saturday. Nothing this week takes real skill, only clicks — it is the cheapest week in the semester to catch up.

weekPlan.aero: Fusion fundamentals: sketch mode, constraints, dimensions. Product Design Online on YouTube or Autodesk’s beginner series. Do not model anything real yet.
weekPlan.aeroDone: You can draw a fully-constrained sketch (all black, no blue lines) without following a video.
weekPlan.py: Python refresher: variables, functions, control flow, running a script from the terminal.
weekPlan.pyDone: A script you wrote runs from the command line and prints a result.
weekPlan.apps: ORG FAIR WEEK. Find TREL / Longhorn Racing / Texas Aerial Robotics — Instagram, Discord, the fair. Apply to all three. Build the 30-employer target list with careers-page URLs.
weekPlan.debt: The org fair does not repeat. If something has to slip this week, slip the CAD tutorials, not the team applications.

weekPlan.aero: Extrude, revolve, fillet, chamfer. Start the phone stand: sketch the profile, extrude, add a lip.
weekPlan.aeroDone: Phone stand modeled in Fusion. Not printed yet.
weekPlan.py: Functions and modules. Start the Engineering Calculator: axial stress, sigma = F/A.
weekPlan.pyDone: A stress() function that takes force and area and returns stress, with one test.
weekPlan.apps: WAVE 1 — NASA OSTEM Spring 2027 (hard deadline Sep 14, write it yourself), Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Boeing, RTX. Email 3 UT ASE/ME professors about research spots.
weekPlan.debt: Labor Day Monday means no Python block. Move it to Tuesday evening or accept a 2-hour Python week.

weekPlan.aero: Print the phone stand. Learn your slicer: layer height, infill, supports, orientation. Photograph it and write the README section.
weekPlan.aeroDone: PROJECT 1 DONE — CAD file, photo, and README on GitHub.
weekPlan.py: Input validation and units. Add strain and Young’s modulus to the calculator.
weekPlan.pyDone: Three working functions that reject bad input instead of crashing.
weekPlan.apps: WAVE 2 starts. 2-3 apps: L3Harris, General Dynamics. M 427J Exam 1 is Friday, so keep the Sunday block short.
weekPlan.debt: A failed print is not a missed day — log it in Weekly_Log as a real lesson. Reprinting counts.

weekPlan.aero: Desk organizer. Practice parametric dimensions — drive the model from a parameters table so one number changes the whole part.
weekPlan.py: NumPy: arrays, vectorized math, why loops are slow.
weekPlan.pyDone: Compute stress across an array of 100 loads in one line.
weekPlan.apps: 2-3 apps: SpaceX, Firefly Aerospace. You have one printed part now — name it in the application.
weekPlan.debt: If CAD slips, the Saturday block absorbs it. If Python slips two weeks running, cut Coursera and keep Python.

weekPlan.aero: Print and document the desk organizer.
weekPlan.aeroDone: PROJECT 2 DONE on GitHub. Two parts in the portfolio.
weekPlan.py: Beam deflection: cantilever and simply-supported formulas.
weekPlan.pyDone: A deflection() function matching a textbook example to 3 significant figures.
weekPlan.apps: Finish Wave 2: GE Aerospace, Honeywell, Collins, Blue Origin. TARGET — 13 apps total by Sep 30.
weekPlan.debt: HEAVY WEEK: Thermo Exam 1 Wed 9/30, Statics Test 1 Thu 10/1. Coursework wins. Push all build work to Saturday and accept it.

weekPlan.aero: Servo mount. Look up the SG90 datasheet, model to real dimensions. Learn clearance fits and tolerances — this part has to actually fit a physical object.
weekPlan.aeroDone: Mount modeled from datasheet dimensions, not guesses.
weekPlan.py: Factor of safety plus a command-line menu tying the functions together.
weekPlan.pyDone: Calculator runs end to end from the terminal.
weekPlan.apps: WAVE 3 starts: NASA Pathways on USAJOBS (opens ~Oct 1), Texas Instruments. M 427J Exam 2 is Friday.
weekPlan.debt: The servo mount is the single most reused part in this whole plan — Stage 2 depends on it. Do not skip ahead of it.

weekPlan.aero: Print the mount, test fit, iterate. Expect two or three attempts.
weekPlan.aeroDone: PROJECT 3 DONE — servo fits, documented, with the failed attempts photographed too.
weekPlan.py: Matplotlib: your first plot, stress vs load.
weekPlan.pyDone: A saved .png with axes labeled and units shown.
weekPlan.debt: Tolerance iteration is the lesson here. If it fits first try you probably guessed the dimensions — check them against the datasheet.

weekPlan.aero: Assemblies and joints: a two-gear assembly or a working hinge. This is what separates "I know CAD" from "I can hand this to a machinist."
weekPlan.aeroDone: An assembly with a joint that actually moves in Fusion.
weekPlan.py: Plot formatting: labels, legends, gridlines, publication quality.
weekPlan.pyDone: Three clean plots you would put in a report.
weekPlan.apps: 2-3 apps: Chevron, ExxonMobil. Thermo Exam 2 is Wed 10/21.
weekPlan.debt: Exam week. Build work goes to Saturday. This is what the Saturday catch-up block exists for.

weekPlan.aero: Drawings: a dimensioned drawing sheet and an exploded view. Then write the Stage 1 portfolio page.
weekPlan.aeroDone: STAGE 1 COMPLETE — 4 parts, drawings, portfolio page live.
weekPlan.py: Write tests. Pytest or plain asserts, either is fine.
weekPlan.pyDone: A test suite that passes and catches one deliberate bug.
weekPlan.apps: Halliburton, Tesla. TARGET — 22 apps total by Oct 31. Statics Test 2 Thu 10/29, M 427J Exam 3 Fri 10/30.
weekPlan.debt: Hardest 48 hours of your semester on Thu-Fri. Do the applications Sunday BEFORE you start exam prep, not after.

weekPlan.aero: Electronics begin. Breadboard basics, Ohm’s law, reading a schematic, then blink an LED. Paul McWhorter’s series or Random Nerd Tutorials.
weekPlan.aeroDone: An LED blinking from wiring you did yourself, without a tutorial open.
weekPlan.py: Finish the calculator: README, docstrings, push.
weekPlan.pyDone: PYTHON ENGINEERING CALCULATOR COMPLETE on GitHub. Resume line earned.
weekPlan.apps: WAVE 4 — your best-odds wave. Rocket Lab, Axiom Space, Intuitive Machines. You now have 4 CAD parts and a Python tool to talk about.
weekPlan.debt: If the ESP32 kit has not arrived, this is the week it hurts. Order it in week 1.

weekPlan.aero: Button input and debouncing. Why a button press registers five times and how to stop it.
weekPlan.aeroDone: A button toggles the LED reliably, no double-fires.
weekPlan.py: ESP32 / Arduino C++ basics: how the syntax differs from Python, pinMode, digitalWrite.
weekPlan.pyDone: You can read an Arduino sketch and say what each line does.
weekPlan.apps: Sierra Space, Venus Aerospace, Moog. Thermo Exam 3 is Wed 11/18 next week — start reviewing now.
weekPlan.debt: Debouncing takes longer than it looks. Budget the Saturday block for it.

weekPlan.aero: Servo sweep. PWM, angle control, powering a servo without browning out the board.
weekPlan.aeroDone: Servo sweeps 0 to 180 and holds commanded angles.
weekPlan.py: Serial output, timing, millis() vs delay() and why delay() blocks everything.
weekPlan.pyDone: Live data streaming to the serial monitor.
weekPlan.apps: JPL, Johns Hopkins APL. FFRDCs — a fraction of the volume of the famous names. Thermo Exam 3 Wed.
weekPlan.debt: Thanksgiving is next week with no classes. Anything you owe, that week absorbs it — plan 10-15 hrs there.

weekPlan.aero: INTEGRATION. Servo into your printed mount, wired, coded, filmed. This is the whole point of Stage 2.
weekPlan.aeroDone: A working mechanism plus a 30-second demo video.
weekPlan.py: Read serial into Python, write a CSV.
weekPlan.pyDone: A data pipeline running hardware to CSV to a plot.
weekPlan.apps: The Aerospace Corporation, AFRL. Statics Test 3 is Thu 12/3.
weekPlan.debt: If integration is not done by Sunday, it moves into finals week and then winter break. Do not let it slide past Christmas.

weekPlan.aero: Documentation only. Wiring diagram, commented code, README with lessons learned. No new building during finals.
weekPlan.aeroDone: STAGE 2 DOCUMENTED on GitHub. Resume v2 draft started.
weekPlan.py: Plot your CSV data. Close the loop from sensor to graph.
weekPlan.pyDone: One plot generated from data your own hardware produced.
weekPlan.apps: Nothing new. Finals: Thermo Thu 12/10, Statics Mon 12/14 10:30 AM.
weekPlan.debt: Coursework only this week. The late-December application wave (12 companies) is scheduled for Dec 27.
